contracts.numerical: Immutable exact row-major RGBA8 UNORM snapshot; independent alpha, pixel centers, nearest/linear and independent axis tile modes; dimensions1..4096 and max16MiB before copy/native
contracts.native_raw: Android setInputBuffer only; no native Skiko0.9.37.4 raw image API; never substitute Image.makeShader
contracts.portable_sampler: Explicit ShaderNode.rgba8Sampler companion extension, at most64texels/256float components/1024uniform bytes; generated constant-index dispatch + fourtap bilinear; normal NESTED capability only
contracts.nested: Immutable sourcefree ShaderNode.snapshot with explicit frozen values/time/dimensions(default1x1), no implicit parent clock/content/backdrop; max4levels32occurrences; same-source siblings independently bound; cycles impossible through public immutable construction and defensively diagnosed
contracts.declaration_check: Narrow token-aware single uniform shader name; coverage rejects comma shader declarations, shader arrays, macros/preprocessor/quotes and unterminated comments; ordinary float/vector arrays retained
contracts.closed_owners: Skia/Android native sessions and DefinitionShaderSession drop owned output/configuration references, reject closed getters and refresh; saved outputs survive owner and cache closure.
contracts.diagnostics: Deepest child source and alias/definition path retained in existing CompilationError; parent alias/setter errors retain parent source
contracts.live: Explicit FRAME_DATA/FRAME_NESTED kinds and retained provider reference identity; complete snapshot validation before native compile/bind; unchanged paused revision does not refresh, each actual data/child bind creates fresh native state; no uploadcache/performance claim
contracts.ownership: No native shader allocations retained by reusable nodes/data; existing image handles borrowed. Skia temporary wrappers close after native retains; Android GC/native reference lifetime, no bitmap recycle under active snapshot. Active snapshots survive source eviction/session disposal; no native memory stabilization claim
contracts.tooling: Descriptor metadata excludes payloads/callbacks; draftv3 bounded descriptions with v1/v2 compatibility; actual generated structural/live/portable caller-binding code compiled in separate consumers; stock UI requires host adapter for imported application data
contracts.migration: Two new sealed Uniform subclasses and enum members require exhaustive source when updates; all old JVM signatures retained, no new sealed ShaderError subtype or mandatory factory member
